title: VTC Admin Actions — Show — payload
description: Fetch one administrative action by its identifier — the read a requester follows after the community answers a gated operation with trust-task-next-step (continuation `proceed`, hint {actionId}). The enumeration sibling is vtc/admin/actions/list/0.1. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

actionId.description: The action to fetch — from a next-step hint, a list entry, or a notification.

Response.title: VTC Admin Actions — Show — response payload
Response.description: The action as the caller is entitled to see it. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.
